items.title: Goldman Slashes Tesla Q3 Delivery Forecast to 435,000: What Do Prediction Markets Say?
items.summary: Goldman Sachs has cut its third-quarter delivery forecast for Tesla Inc. (NASDAQ:TSLA) to 435,000 vehicles, while prediction traders are centered around 480,000. Goldman analyst Mark Delaney lowered his estimate from 490,000 while maintaining a Neutral rating and $360 price target....
